focus: Canonicalize the fixed upper-end actor-table record used by the backward allocator and reverse-slot consumers.
contracts: ACTOR_TABLE_BASE is 0x00FF7E40 and each actor record is 0x42 bytes.
0x00FF8470 equals actor-table slot 24 and is the starting record for the backward pool scan.
Reverse-slot consumers address the same fixed record boundary; no independent object identity is assigned to the address.
conclusion: The fixed upper-end backward-pool record is a canonical actor-table slot-24 base rather than an anonymous RAM address.
